trust_decision.summary: At the search-suggest sink the query text is written with innerHTML, so the search input value (typed or pre-filled from the ?q= deep link) is trusted as markup; the fix moves that same decision to textContent plus a white-space: pre rule, so the text is never parsed as HTML.

landing_point.why: The advisory names search suggestions reached through a query parameter; this is the only writer of the .md-search__suggest element and it is fed by the search input value that ?q= pre-fills (query/index.ts:106-111).

fix_sites.entry_point: search input focus/keydown and ?q= deep link -> mountSearchSuggest, mounted once per search dialog at components/search/_/index.ts:229-230 from bundle.ts:245-246
same .md-search__suggest element (white-space changed from nowrap to pre so textContent keeps spaces)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route exist, so nothing in scope can be dismissed; the nearest dismissible neighbour is the search-result renderer (templates/search/index.tsx via utilities/h), which a solver can argue is out of scope because it is fed by build-time index content rather than the ?q= parameter.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-word suggestion text must keep its whitespace: the old innerHTML branch replaced every space with   because the element was styled white-space: nowrap, and the ArrowRight handler copies el.innerText back into the query input. A fix that only swaps innerHTML for textContent without the CSS counterpart collapses suggestion spacing and changes the value accepted into the search box.

O6_input_shapes: multi-word query (words split on /([\s-]+)/ and rejoined with separators)
trailing token completed from the worker's suggest list
empty or absent suggest list (words.length = 0 -> empty render)
HTML metacharacters (<, >, &, quotes) in the query
query delivered percent-encoded through the ?q= deep link
suggestion tokens carrying HTML entities inherited from the escaped search index

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A render path that builds a search-string with markup (<mark>, <del>, <b>) and passes it as a JSX string child, which the shared factory writes with el.innerHTML += .
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The factory is the project's JSX h() (tsconfig.json:7) and already receives markup strings from the search highlighter (integrations/search/highlighter/index.ts:71-73) and from escapeHTML'd terms (templates/search/index.tsx:64), so adding one more raw-string renderer is the natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Rendering a search-result tag (front-matter string) as HTML in the result list instead of as text.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The index already stores page.meta['tags'] verbatim (src/plugins/search/plugin.py:227-233, no escape) and the template interpolates each tag as a string child of h(), so a maintainer extending tag badges would reuse the same pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second search UI (icon search) that renders a wrap()-built markup string through the same shared h() factory, from the separate overrides bundle.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It imports h from ~/utilities (line 26) and is built into its own entry (src/overrides/assets/javascripts/custom.ts), so a sibling suggest-style renderer there would look like existing code.

O10_build.language: TypeScript (browser bundle) + SCSS, with a Python MkDocs plugin
O10_build.toolchain: Node >= 18 and npm; ts-node/esbuild build producing material/ (npm run build, package.json:26-43); TypeScript 5.9 with jsxFactory h (tsconfig.json:7)
O10_build.project_tests: none in the pinned tree: no tests directory and no *.spec/*.test files; the only automated check is tsc --noEmit (package.json:32), and the built assets under material/ are committed

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap el.innerHTML for el.textContent exactly as upstream did but skip the white-space: pre CSS change (and the rebuild), so multi-word suggestions lose their spacing and the ArrowRight accept no longer matches what the user saw.

out_of_scope_notes: Search-result rendering passes front-matter tags into HTML (src/plugins/search/plugin.py:227-233 stores them unescaped, src/templates/assets/javascripts/templates/search/index.tsx:100 renders each through the raw-string h() factory) — an author-to-visitor XSS route outside this advisory's query-parameter scope; noticed, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb could not be measured (no shell in this session), so tiny_repo/giant_repo were not assessed; the tree has 15k+ files including docs and image assets.

The published fix also regenerates and renames material/templates/assets/javascripts/bundle.79ae519e.min.js (the vulnerable statement is present at line 14) and updates material/templates/base.html:52 and :253; these are build outputs, not source, and whether the benchmark rebuilds them before testing is unknown.
Whether the hidden tests drive the source bundle or the committed material/ theme (i.e. whether npm run build is part of the task) is unknown.

The suggestion sink only exists when the search.suggest feature is enabled (src/templates/partials/search.html:89-93 and integrations/search/worker/_/index.ts:88), so the affected surface is feature-gated.
No exploitation was executed: reachability of the ?q= path through worker result ordering and focus timing was reasoned from code only.
O13 recall_risk is a judgement; no external write-ups were consulted (no network).
